title: Could Elon Musk Buy a Country?

frames.title: Musk và Bồ Đào Nha
frames.cue: Could Elon Musk buy a country?

frames.title: Tài sản ròng ước tính
frames.cue: On October first, twenty twenty-six, Forbes estimated his net worth at about nine hundred and thirty-six billion dollars.

frames.title: GDP một năm
frames.cue: The World Bank puts Portugal's economic output in twenty twenty-five at roughly three hundred and forty-six point six billion dollars.

frames.title: Hai số đo khác loại
frames.cue: The first number is about two point seven times the second.

frames.title: GDP và một năm sản xuất
frames.cue: Gross domestic product, or GDP, measures the value of final goods and services produced within an economy during a period, usually a year.

frames.title: Tài sản nằm ở đâu
frames.cue: Net worth is an estimate of assets minus liabilities. For Musk, large portions of that wealth are tied to ownership interests in businesses such as SpaceX and Tesla.

frames.title: Bán tài sản và điều kiện
frames.cue: One route would be selling assets. That requires buyers. Selling a very large position can affect the price, and taxes and restrictions may affect the proceeds. The headline estimate does not guarantee what every asset would bring in a sale.

frames.title: Dân số dùng trong ví dụ
frames.cue: The World Bank reports Portugal's twenty twenty-five population at about ten point eight million people.

frames.title: Chi phí một lần chi trả
frames.cue: Using that rounded population, the total would be about one hundred and eight billion dollars. That is roughly twelve percent of the nine hundred and thirty-six billion dollar estimate.

frames.title: Tám lần đầy đủ và phần còn lại
frames.cue: At one hundred and eight billion dollars a year, that starting amount would cover eight complete annual rounds and part of a ninth.

frames.title: Xây dựng và vận hành
frames.cue: Picture a new hospital. Funding its construction would be a major contribution. But opening the doors begins another set of expenses: staff, medicine, electricity, maintenance, and replacement equipment.

frames.title: Chủ quyền và quyền sở hữu
frames.cue: Sovereignty is not a bonus attached to a sufficiently large property transaction.

frames.title: Theo dòng tiền
frames.cue: A billionaire headline gives us a number. Following the money shows us what that number can change, how long it can support a commitment, and where its power reaches a limit.
